summary: Algorhythm Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a settlement agreement with Continuation Capital, Inc. (CCI) to resolve liabilities of $1,928,014 by issuing up to 5,000,000 shares of common stock, capped at 19.99% of outstanding shares. The settlement was court-approved under Section 3(a)(10) of the Securities Act, exempting the share issuance from registration. Separately, the company entered into amended employment agreements with its CEO and CFO, which are routine compensatory arrangements. No premium, price per share, or acquisition terms are stated. This filing does not represent a special situation such as a restructuring, acquisition, or going-private transaction; it is a routine liability settlement and executive compensation update. The share issuance is a non-ordinary payoff mechanism, not an equity offering or change of control. There is no strategic review, tender offer, or activist campaign disclosed. The filing lacks material terms typical of a special-situation event.
